turns.question: How many leads did every 100 euros of social ad spend get us in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no leads-per-spend metric, so I cannot give leads per 100 euros; the closest metrics are cost per lead and its inputs, and for social in September 2026 (1 to 30 September) they show 40 leads, 2,100 EUR of ad spend and a cost per lead of 52.5 EUR. Freshness: Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
